en.title: HEIC to JPG – Convert iPhone HEIC Photos to JPG Online Free
en.description: Convert HEIC to JPG online for free. Drop one or many iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos, pick the quality and size, and download JPG files that open anywhere. Runs in your browser – nothing is uploaded.

quality.label: Quality
quality.help: Higher quality keeps more detail but makes a bigger file. 90 is a good default.

maxEdge.label: Max size
maxEdge.help: Shrinks the long side of large photos. Original keeps the full resolution.

background.label: Background
background.help: JPG cannot be transparent, so any transparent areas are filled with this color.

faq: Why won't my HEIC photos open on Windows?
HEIC is Apple's photo format and many Windows apps and websites cannot read it. Converting to JPG makes the photos open everywhere.
Are my photos uploaded?
No. Each photo is decoded and converted on your device with your browser and never sent to a server.

HEIC 는 애플 사진 형식이라 윈도우 프로그램과 웹사이트 상당수가 읽지 못합니다. JPG 로 바꾸면 어디서나 열립니다.
